browser: Saved trace, code map, source navigation, read-only catalog; desktop and319px checked without paid requests.

privacy.new_public_exports: Allowlisted metrics and short saved-demo projections; no provider IDs/system messages/runtime credentials or absolute machine paths.
privacy.screenshot: Workflow/code region only; excludes private trace identifiers and local run timestamps.
privacy.historical_receipts: Account-level budget/remaining-billing status removed; experiment-specific usage/cost retained.

ci: Credential-free Linux contracts and public evidence checks run on push/PR; inspect repository Actions for the delivered commit.
limitations: Development evidence recall is not answer accuracy.
Synthetic SQL timings are not end-to-end production p95/RPS.
No independent new-company holdout or financial-calculator acceptance.
